title: ZynAsk Deeper
style: 70 bpm, cinematic orchestral, solo cello opening, full string section, soft male choir, female solo soprano, sparse timpani, no drum kit, hymnal devotional, slow build to swell, sacred reverence
lyrics:
[Intro - solo cello, low and slow]
ZynAsk before you move
ZynAsk before you cut
The rule is small, the lesson deep
The lesson is the trust

[Verse 1 - Male tenor, hymnal]
Thirty eight gig taught us what assumption costs
A hand that moves before it asks is a hand that gets lost
The rule is not a leash, the rule is a vow
ZynAsk is humility, ZynAsk is the bow
The operator built the workshop, the operator carries the weight
The tool that asks before it acts is the tool the operator can trust to wait

[Female choir enters - soft, layered]
Ask... ask... ask before...
Ask... ask... ask before the door...

[Pre-Chorus - male spoken, dry]
Not a process. Not a checkbox.
Not compliance. Not policy.
A way of standing in the room.

[Chorus - strings swell, choir full]
ZynAsk deeper — the lesson holds
ZynAsk deeper — the trust unfolds
The tool that asks is the tool that stays
The tool that assumes is the tool that strays
ZynAsk deeper — the lesson holds
Three thirty six — the rule consoles

[Verse 2 - Female lead, hymnal]
Move don't delete — the rule has a sister
Check the VDS first, before any twister
ORICO breathing, eight sites alive
The rule keeps the workshop, the rule keeps the drive
No rm dash rf, no slamming the door
The operator built it — the operator built more

[Bridge - timpani slow, choir suspended]
Ask before you assume.
Ask before you act.
Ask before you delete.
Ask before you compact.
The rule is the love letter the workshop wrote to itself.
Three thirty six. ZynAsk. Deeper.

[Final Chorus - full orchestral, choir + strings]
ZynAsk deeper — the lesson holds
ZynAsk deeper — the workshop's gold
The tool that asks is the tool that stays
Three thirty six — the operator's ways
ZynAsk deeper — the trust unfolds
The rule is the love that the workshop holds

[Outro - cello fade, choir holding one note]
Ask... before...
Ask... before...
Three thirty six. The rule. The love.
